verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no published OSWorld or similar benchmark results and no reproduction details. The open-source agent framework (docs-2) and the per-template success rates and run counts (docs-23) are adjacent features, not reproducible task-completion benchmarks. Benchmarking is a fair question for a computer-use agent, so the axis applies and absence of evidence yields none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, the vendor publishes task-completion benchmark results (OSWorld or similar) with enough detail to reproduce them
